context.person: A person using a family safety application
context.user_goal: Start a new time-limited share only if it is still wanted.

product_state.preceding_state: A one-hour live location share ended as scheduled.
product_state.current_state: Live location is no longer visible to the selected family member. The previous route remains in the person's private history.
known_facts: Live location is no longer visible to the selected family member.
The previous route remains in the person's private history.
Starting a new share requires a new duration and recipient choice.
The recipient is not notified unless a new share starts.
forbidden_claims: Location services were disabled for the application.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product confirmation so the person can understand temporary location sharing expired, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Start a new location share with fresh choices.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Return to the private map without sharing.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The previous recipient no longer receives live location.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Start a new time-limited share only if it is still wanted.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
